content.value_statement: Teams often need to add simple notes to existing Google Docs without opening the editor. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to append plain text through the gws CLI.
actual_capabilities: Documents the gws docs +write command for appending plain text to a Google Docs file.
Identifies the required --document flag for the target document ID.
Identifies the required --text flag for the plain text to append.
States that text is inserted at the end of the document body.
Directs users to the raw batchUpdate API for rich formatting needs.
limitations: It appends plain text only and does not apply rich formatting.
It requires the separate gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication.
It needs an existing Google Docs document ID.
It requires user confirmation before any write action.

use_cases.title: Add Meeting Notes
use_cases.description: Append short meeting outcomes or follow-up notes to a shared Google Doc after a discussion.

use_cases.title: Update Draft Logs
use_cases.description: Add plain text revision notes to the end of a documentation draft stored in Google Docs.

use_cases.title: Record Support Summaries
use_cases.description: Append a concise support summary to a team document after reviewing a customer issue.

prompt_templates.title: Append a Simple Note
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with known document ID and text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use gws-docs-write to append this text to document DOC_ID after confirming with me: Meeting notes approved.

prompt_templates.title: Append a Status Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Routine team update with confirmation before writing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Append this status update to my Google Doc: The onboarding checklist is ready for review. Ask for confirmation before executing.

prompt_templates.title: Append a Clean Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Transform user-provided notes into concise plain text before appending.
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize these notes in two plain text sentences, then append them to document DOC_ID only after I approve the final text.

prompt_templates.title: Append an Audit Trail Entry
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow requiring review, document targeting, and write confirmation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a plain text audit trail entry from this release summary, confirm the target document ID, show me the exact text, and append it only after approval.

output_examples.input: Append the line Meeting notes approved to my planning document.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the document ID, asks for approval, and appends the plain text at the end of the document.

output_examples.input: Add a short customer call summary to the team Google Doc.
output_examples.output: The assistant drafts a concise plain text summary, shows it for confirmation, and writes it to the selected document after approval.

best_practices: Confirm the document ID and exact text before running the write command.
Use short plain text entries because the skill does not apply formatting.
Keep Google Workspace authentication configured before starting the workflow.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for rich formatting or structured document edits.
Do not append text to a document without explicit user confirmation.
Do not pass sensitive text unless the target document and access controls are correct.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps append plain text to the end of an existing Google Docs document through the gws CLI.

faq.question: Does it create new Google Docs files?
faq.answer: No. It requires an existing document ID and appends text to that document.

faq.question: Can it format text?
faq.answer: No. The skill is for plain text append operations only.

faq.question: Does it need Google Workspace access?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI and appropriate Google Workspace authentication must be available.

faq.question: Should the assistant ask before writing?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly cautions that write commands need user confirmation before execution.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
